up: For assay CHEMBL4649947, return the exact activity values (standard_value with standard_relation) and standard units for all tested compounds. Include the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for each compound. Do not filter by activity type or units.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649947'
